kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: When caring for aging family members becomes cost prohibitive
wire.summary: AARP reports family caregivers are spending 60% more than they were five years ago. Journalist Paula Span discusses the rising costs of caregiving and senior living, and the options available to us.

wire.title: For Ukraine's Kherson region, a short ceasefire meant a momentary return to normal life
wire.summary: In Kherson city, usually seething with Russian drones, friends met at cafes, families were out together and shoppers stocked up. "The city seems alive," said one resident, "just like it used to be."

wire.title: Indian navy rescues 20 crew from Iranian fishing boat hijacked off Somalia
wire.summary: he operation involved a warship, a maritime surveillance aircraft and marine commandos. The hijacking followed a resurgence of Somali piracy across the Gulf of Aden and western Indian Ocean.

wire.title: Control of Congress is at stake today. And, judge to consider motion in Clancy case
wire.summary: Election Day is here, and voters are heading to the polls in an election that may change control of Congress. And, a judge is considering whether to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case.

wire.title: Death toll hits 29 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with 48 still missing
wire.summary: Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles across nine regions, President Zelenskyy said in an online post that noted the barrage coincided with U.S. elections.

wire.title: Four types of House races to watch on election night to know how it might go
wire.summary: As polls close on Election Day and results start rolling in, these are some of the House races that will help explain how the midterms are unfolding.

wire.title: New restrictions at Texas Tech are changing what professors can teach
wire.summary: The rules have led to changes in course materials, prompted accusations of censorship and fueled pushback from faculty and students, including faculty departures, student protests and a federal lawsuit.

wire.title: How NPR makes race calls in the 2026 election
wire.summary: Race calls are a critical part of election night and NPR partners with the Associated Press to make those calls. Here's how we do it.

wire.title: From 'model minority' to target, anti-Indian hate on the rise
wire.summary: A massacre allegedly targeting Hindu Americans was recently thwarted, but researchers say it helps to illustrate a growing and increasingly mainstream hate directed at South Asians in the U.S.

wire.title: A new cold war: hackers target fridges across the globe
wire.summary: NPR investigated cyberattacks on the digital devices that control industrial refrigerators, revealing the extent to which operational technology is exposed to damage and disruption.

wire.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
wire.summary: Planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria and Italy have been checked for explosives following separate threats.

wire.title: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision
wire.summary: Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel dies aged 30 after an on-field collision during a Spanish second-division match.

wire.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
wire.summary: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.

wire.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
wire.summary: At least 38 people are killed in 24 hours and Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky warns dozens more could be trapped under rubble.

wire.title: Libya's top religious authority rules against wearing Nike clothes
wire.summary: The US company was named after the Greek goddess of victory, so the Dar al-Ifta said displaying its logo was unIslamic.

wire.title: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
wire.summary: Supermarkets have reported problems from Estonia and Sweden to Portugal and Italy and many retainers have been forced to discard food.
